newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Geo started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Geo started as buy.

text.p: Credit Lyonnais Securities began coverage of Mexican constructor Corporacion Geo with a buy recommendation, it said on Friday.
-- Geo is the principal beneficiary of a flood of housing construction in Mexico, analyst Rafael Diaz said in a report.
-- "Geo's current backlog of 23,000 mortgages should enable the company to grow its unit sales in Mexico by 43 pct in 1997," he wrote.
-- "In addition, the company will begin operations in Chile and the U.S. over the next three months, which should boost operating margins over the long term."
-- Geo shares in Mexico City stood at 43.05 pesos on Friday, up 15 centavos.
-- Its ADRs trade over the counter as pinksheets in New York. ((-- Daniel Perez-Whitaker, Monterrey bureau +528 345 7617))
